fusions.name: Muzzle Bellow
fusions.desc: Bellows a concussive blast that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Buckshot Spray
fusions.desc: Looses 5 pellets in a wide spread; each pellet deals 7 damage. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Steadied Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Echoing Crack
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
